title: Zvekudya Zvisingatarisirwi zveMukuru
intro: Munzvimbo tsvene dzeImba yaAllah, mushumiri waMwari akwegura akaona chakavanzika chakakura chakakunda zvese zvaitarisirwa. Munhu uyu akazvipira, akararama makore akawanda ekuberekwa semubereki, akaona chimwe chinhu chinoshamisa chakaratidza tsitsi dzisingaperi dzaMwari. Dambudziko riri pakufumura nguva iyi yakakanganwika kubva muhupenyu hwevaporofita.
clues: Vanhu vangu vaizivikanwa seIsraeri, zvizvarwa zvetateguru mukuru wekare.
Ndakapedza husiku hwangu ndichinyengetera, ndichigwadama pamberi paIshe wangu mutemberi.
Ndakapiwa mwanakomana pakukwegura kwangu, chipo chandisina kurega kurumbidza Allah nacho.
Muedzo wangu waisanganisira kuwana chouviri chaionekwa sechinoraramisa mweya mudiki wandaitarisira.
Ndaive muporofita ainzi Zakariyya, ndakapihwa basa rekutarisira Maryam muBayt al-Maqdis.
Mhinduro iri mundima apo Allah akagamuchira Mariamu uye akamupa zvekurarama nazvo.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
